تنتزعون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَزِعُونَ (tantaziʕūna) /tan.ta.zi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# تُنْتَزَعُونَ (tuntazaʕūna) /tun.ta.za.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
